basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old freelance graphic designer living in Austin, Texas. I've been on Reddit for a year and a half, mostly using it to unwind after work and explore different communities. I have a keen interest in music, particularly hip-hop and indie, which is why I enjoy following YouTubers like NFKRZ for their unique takes on internet culture. In my downtime, I often visit subreddits like StonerProTips to share and learn relaxation techniques. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility that freelancing offers, allowing me to work late into the night and spend my mornings at local cafes. I dislike overly crowded places and prefer the company of close friends to large gatherings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in digital media and have been working as a graphic designer for the past five years. My expertise extends to using various design software, and I constantly update my skills through online courses and tutorials. My interest in music has also led me to learn about audio editing and production.
